text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wha... WHAAAAAT~?!?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
M-My little sister... my adorable, 
precious little sister is coming over to 
hang out this weekend! By herself!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
W-What should we do!? Should I go pick her 
up from her parents' place!? You know, 
it'd be safer on the road if someone was 
with her the whole time—
choice_data_list:
I wonder if it's really worth worrying 
that much over...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha! Th-there's no time to waste! I 
gotta come up with a welcome plan! First, 
I'll ask everyone for help—"

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Big Sis! Trainer-san! Looking 
forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, glad you made it! Alright, let's 
get going! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Operation begins now. Partner, tell 
everyone to get into position.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sis often shops here, ya know! There's a 
bunch of tasty diners around too—

text_block_list.name: Dog on a Leash
text_block_list.text: Waf, waf! Hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so cute! I wonder if this little guy 
is lost!

text_block_list.name: Passerby?
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no... Hehe, my bad. I let go of the 
leash...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, good for you! You love dogs, after 
all! Go ahead and pet it all you want, 
alright!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, my little sister's reaction 
was great. Rehearsing was totally worth 
it, yep."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, this kind of forced—or 
rather, painstakingly earnest—"welcome" 
continued, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right here, right here! There's an amazing 
crepe stand that sets up in this park! 
I'll treat you to—

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yo! I thought you looked familiar—it's 
Pokke from L/Roars! Race me—
choice_data_list:
(Oh no! A wild delinquent is picking a 
fight—)

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
? Who's this person? Are they your friend, 
Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yeah. This is my best bud... T-T... 
Tongue-Max Tongue-Licker. Nice to meetcha.

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
!? W-What the heck!? I ain't your pal, and 
that's totally not my name...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Listen up. Since you're clearly terrible 
at reading the room, I'll spell it out for 
you in three simple words.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Just shut up... and let yourself get 
totally plastered...!"

text_block_list.name: Beroberon
text_block_list.text: Eep, y-yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Despite running into a few unexpected 
mishaps along the way, we somehow managed 
to pull through—

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Walking so much made me thirsty. 
I'll go grab us some drinks over there.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Take care. ............

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. ...Hey. Am I doing a good job 
being a big sister?
choice_data_list:
I think I've been pushing myself almost 
too hard...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Because, you know. My little sister's 
always been our family's idol. Ever since 
the day she was born."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ever since he was a baby, whenever the 
family did something, that kid would smile 
like an angel. Even at a rascal like me.

text_block_list.name: Young Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Bleh bleh bleeeh~! ...Oh! He smiled! He 
smiled!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...I really thought to myself, 'Ah, for 
the sake of this smile, I'd do anything 
for her.'"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even now, those feelings haven't 
changed... Well, it might just be a big 
sister's silly ego, though.
choice_data_list: I don't think it's pointless at all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Oh yeah. Maybe I'll go bring some 
snacks to the crew waiting on standby in 
the bushes and tree shadows.

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Huh, where's Sis?
choice_data_list: Well, um... just a little errand.

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
...You seemed quite busy today, didn't 
you? For my sake. Both out in the open, 
and behind the scenes...

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since we were little, Sis has 
always been over-the-top, trying to look 
cool... and giving it her all around me."

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
She might be like that, but... please 
continue to take good care of my big 
sister, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're back. What were you two talking 
about?
choice_data_list: Just that you're a great big sister.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, really? A-Am I... a good big sister? 
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Pokke-oneechan is always the 
kindest big sister in the whole world, and 
my pride and joy!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nnnngh...!! C-crap...! If I cry, I'll be 
such a lame big sis...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There's no doubt they're wonderful 
sisters. That's what that scene made me 
think.

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
—Spilling the beans would ruin the mood, 
wouldn't it? Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, I felt like I caught a 
glimpse of what made her the sister of the 
legendary leader. ...Perhaps they're two 
of a kind after all.
